integrity: General proof by integral invariant and strict Vieta descent; exact finite consistency checks only, not an independent proof of infinite quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Coprime positive integers only; excludes equal pair except (1,1). Primality of quadratic values is not proved infinitely often. Stronger unindexed quadratic-congruence results could affect priority.
title: Complete coprime two-cycles for the first positive shift of a reciprocal quadratic divisibility system
